_why: The statements PostgresBackend.update_rows and create_rows compose, for the field shapes the kernel composes natively. Two tests read this file: harness/test_shims.py drives the FORK's backend against a stub model and asserts it produces these strings, and kernel/tests/pure.rs asserts the kernel's composer produces them. One literal, derived twice, so a change on either side fails against the other rather than against a copy of itself. Regenerate with harness/write_sql_contract.py after an intended change to the fork's composition.

cases.name: values, a whole-value translated column
cases.sql:
UPDATE "res_partner"
                SET "title" = CASE WHEN "__tmp"."title"::JSONB IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT CASE
                WHEN echo.lang IS NOT NULL AND (
                    echo.lang = 'en_US'
                    OR held.value ->> echo.lang IS DISTINCT FROM held.value ->> 'en_US'
                )
                THEN held.value - ('_echo:' || echo.lang)
                ELSE held.value
            END
            FROM (SELECT COALESCE("res_partner"."title", jsonb_build_object(
                        'en_US', jsonb_path_query_first("__tmp"."title"::JSONB, '$.*'),
                        '_echo:' || (
                            jsonb_path_query_first("__tmp"."title"::JSONB, '$.keyvalue().key') #>> '{}'
                        ), ''
                    )) || "__tmp"."title"::JSONB AS value) AS held
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT substr(key, 7) AS lang FROM jsonb_object_keys(held.value) AS key
                WHERE left(key, 6) = '_echo:' LIMIT 1
            ) AS echo ON TRUE) END
                FROM (VALUES (%s, %s)) AS "__tmp"("id", "title")
                WHERE "res_partner"."id" = "__tmp"."id"

cases.name: uniform, a whole-value translated column binds its value four times
cases.sql:
UPDATE "res_partner" SET "title" = CASE WHEN %s::JSONB IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT CASE
                WHEN echo.lang IS NOT NULL AND (
                    echo.lang = 'en_US'
                    OR held.value ->> echo.lang IS DISTINCT FROM held.value ->> 'en_US'
                )
                THEN held.value - ('_echo:' || echo.lang)
                ELSE held.value
            END
            FROM (SELECT COALESCE("res_partner"."title", jsonb_build_object(
                        'en_US', jsonb_path_query_first(%s::JSONB, '$.*'),
                        '_echo:' || (
                            jsonb_path_query_first(%s::JSONB, '$.keyvalue().key') #>> '{}'
                        ), ''
                    )) || %s::JSONB AS value) AS held
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT substr(key, 7) AS lang FROM jsonb_object_keys(held.value) AS key
                WHERE left(key, 6) = '_echo:' LIMIT 1
            ) AS echo ON TRUE) END WHERE "id" = ANY(%s)
